name: the engine's per-frame draws while the battle's clock holds, replayed
why: Mask 039's hold seen by the replay: both games draw three numbers each frame whatever the battle does (rng, per_frame: the game state's GetRNG and GetRNGSecondary, the main loop's GetRNGSecondary), and a turn's change opened with L takes BN6 four frames more than BN5. rng=follow sees that as the words apart (039); rng=replay keys each draw and finds no twin in BN5's frame for BN6's extra frames' draws, so it reports each. Only a draw of those per-frame routines one game alone made is taken in; any other unmatched draw is still a difference. Specs that take a second Custom screen under the replay (MeddySoul's capsules, drawn by BN5's set-up moved and keyed as BN5's) meet it.
evidence: soul_meddy_capsules and soul_meddy_capsule_used (rng=replay, L at t520): at t524 BN6's draws with no twin are twelve, four frames of 0x08005100 and 0x08005104 (the game state's: per_frame's twin 0x080050EC of BN5's 0x08004C98) and 0x08000320 (the main loop's, the same place in BN5); the cores' frames from t523 to t524 247 in BN5 and 251 in BN6; every other draw matched (the capsules' draw BN5's, 0 unmapped)
mask 039's evidence: BN6 0x0800840C runs the turn's form check before its Custom screen, which BN5's 0x0800773C skips in a battle not linked
